title: Discovery of Novel Polycyclic Polyprenylated Acylphloroglucinols from the Fruits of Garcinia xanthochymus as Antitumor Agents by Suppressing the STAT3 Signaling.
authors: Jin, Shan; Wang, Wen; Gan, Fei; Xie, Wenli; Xu, Jing; Chen, Yu; Mei, Zhinan; Yang, Guangzhong
one_liner_zh: 该文从植物中分离PPAPs并研究其抗肿瘤活性，仅涉及小分子与STAT3蛋白的分子对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系或TF-DNA结合机制，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Pharmacologic studies have revealed that polycyclic polyprenylated acylphloroglucinols (PPAPs) collectively exhibit a broad range of biological activities, including antineoplastic potential. Here, six new PPAPs, named garcixanthochymones F-K (3, 5, 7, 8, 11, and 15), together with nine known analogues were isolated from the fruits of Garcinia xanthochymus. Their structures were elucidated based on the spectroscopic data, including UV, HRESIMS, and NMR, and quantum chemical calculations. All the isolated PPAPs were tested for anti-proliferative activity against four human tumor cell lines, including SGC7901, A549, HepG2, and MCF-7. Most of the PPAPs possessed high anti-proliferative activity with IC(50) values in the range of 0.89 to 36.98 muM, and significant apoptosis was observed in MCF-7 cells exposed to compounds 2 and 5. Besides, docking results showed that compounds 2 and 5 could strongly combine with the Src homology 2 (SH2) domain of STAT3 via hydrogen bond and hydrophobic interaction, which is one of the key oncogenes and crucial therapeutic targets. Furthermore, compounds 2 and 5 efficiently downregulated the expression of p-STAT3(Tyr705) and pivotal effector proteins involved in oncogenic signaling pathways of MCF-7 cells.
abstract_zh: 药理学研究表明，多环聚异戊烯基酰基间苯三酚类化合物（PPAPs）整体展现出广泛的生物活性，包括抗肿瘤潜力。本研究从金丝桃属植物Garcinia xanthochymus的果实中分离出六个新的PPAPs，命名为garcixanthochymones F-K（3、5、7、8、11和15），以及九个已知类似物。其结构基于光谱数据（包括UV、HRESIMS和NMR）及量子化学计算进行阐明。所有分离得到的PPAPs均测试了针对四种人肿瘤细胞系（包括SGC7901、A549、HepG2和MCF-7）的抗增殖活性。大多数PPAPs具有高抗增殖活性，IC(50)值范围为0.89至36.98 μM，并且在暴露于化合物2和5的MCF-7细胞中观察到显著的细胞凋亡。此外，分子对接结果显示，化合物2和5能通过氢键和疏水相互作用与STAT3的Src同源2（SH2）结构域强烈结合，该结构域是关键的致癌基因之一及重要的治疗靶点。进一步地，化合物2和5有效下调了MCF-7细胞中p-STAT3(Tyr705)及参与致癌信号通路的关键效应蛋白的表达。
